_comment: Praxis_build-6bw / -8zd (b2-stitch) — DEFAULT column schema for b2_stitch.py. Two shapes are supported: (1) header-bearing files resolve columns by the alias maps below (normalized case/space/underscore/hyphen-insensitive, exact -> substring precedence, then a documented positional fallback: daily date=col0, OI=last col); (2) HEADER-LESS files (the real semicolon-delimited NinjaTrader export) resolve by the `*_positional` index layouts. The real export is: daily = YYYYMMDD;open;high;low;close;volume (6 cols, NO Open Interest); minute = 'YYYYMMDD HHMMSS';open;high;low;close;volume (field 0 is a single combined timestamp). A 6-col daily has no OI column, so oi_present() is False and the roll follows the volume-only crossover path (D-2026-07-21-A). Copy + edit + pass via `--schema <path>`. Editing this file changes NOTHING about the TRADER-LOCKED roll convention (Vol/OI-crossover + Difference) — it only maps columns.
